Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer surfaced an erroneous birth year from a Wikipedia snippet for John Schlesinger (showing 1963 instead of the correct 1926) without flagging it. This introduces incorrect biographical data that could directly lead to the wrong comparison (mistakenly concluding Tran Anh Hung, 1962, was born earlier than Schlesinger).
